answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the meadow forfeiture publishes up in the plume totals with the karst audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 209 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Retiring an identity early forfeits 18% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
